teams.heading: Winless Fiji met Italy in Udine with a Twickenham rematch at stake
teams.body: Fiji head coach Jake White's side went into Saturday's Nations Championship test against Italy at Udine's Bluenergy Stadium with both teams still chasing a first win in the competition, OnRugby reported. Fiji arrived bottom of Pool Sud without a point after the 15-43 defeat by Ireland in Dublin. The Federazione Italiana Rugby noted that a loss — or a win without a bonus point — would send them into a sixth-place final against Italy at Twickenham's Allianz Stadium on finals weekend.

teams.heading: Itoje's England hammer New Zealand 37-12 to sit top of the log
teams.body: Saturday's Round 6 win at Allianz Stadium, Twickenham, sends captain Maro Itoje's England into Sunday top of the 12-team Nations Championship log, with five wins from six and a points difference of +159. Under head coach Steve Borthwick they had won only four of their previous 20 Tests against South Africa, New Zealand, France, Ireland and Scotland, the Guardian noted. The All Blacks arrived off a 35-28 defeat to Wales, with NZ Rugby chair David Kirk warning of a "serious examination" if they played poorly at Twickenham.

lead.why: England's win over New Zealand is the newest hard event, and the reader has not yet had it.

teams.heading: Matthieu Jalibert returns at fly-half to partner Antoine Dupont against Argentina
teams.body: Jalibert's recall alongside France's Antoine Dupont came as head coach Fabien Galthié tested squad depth amid a series of injuries, according to Americas Rugby News' guide to Saturday's Round 6 test against the Pumas at the Stade de France. Galthié's side, ranked third in the world, went in having lost just twice in 10 Tests this year. Argentina head coach Felipe Contepomi's eighth-ranked team had two wins and a draw from eight matches, the latest a 19-14 win over Italy in Genoa.

teams.heading: Ireland U20 edged 31-29 by Scotland as Paul Neary's conversion drifts wide
teams.body: Ireland U20 began their campaign with a 31-29 defeat at Musgrave Park on Friday, five tries built on a dominant scrum and maul undone by Scotland's sharper goal-kicking, The42 reported. St Mary's out-half Paul Neary had the chance to level at the death, but his conversion slid wide. Full-back Fionn Rowsome opened the scoring, gathering Frankie Óg Sheehan's kick, before first-half yellow cards for lock Jonny Ginnety and UCD's Bernard White let Scotland back in through tries from wing Rory Caldwell and second row James Dalrymple.

lead.why: The Ireland XV rout has already run, so the U20s' last-gasp defeat is the freshest genuinely new Ireland story in the pack.

teams.heading: Darcy Graham and Liam McConnell hat-tricks power Scotland past Japan 67-5
teams.body: Saturday's Nations Championship round-six win at Murrayfield ran to 11 tries. A largely second-string Scotland side led 29-0 at the break in front of a 67,000 sell-out. Wing Darcy Graham's treble took his Scotland try tally to 41. Rookie back-rower Liam McConnell completed his hat-trick three minutes after Japan's Takuro Matsunaga scored a 53rd-minute consolation. Planet Rugby rated four wins from six in the group stage a solid return but noted plenty of grumbles remain about head coach Gregor Townsend.

lead.why: Scotland's 67-5 win over Japan is the fresh senior result and has not yet led this tab.

teams.heading: Steve Tandy rings changes for Australia after 300 tackles against All Blacks
teams.body: Wales head coach Steve Tandy explained the reshuffle for Saturday's Test against Australia on workload grounds after the All Blacks win: "When you make 300 tackles and the ball-in-play time was high, we were always going to make changes." His side was captained by Dewi Lake, with Sam Costelow and scrum-half Tomos Williams in the halves. Exeter's Kane James was among the replacements, in line for his first home Test appearance. Luc Ramos of the French federation was named referee.

lead.why: Senior-side selection news with Tandy's reasoning; the Prem story, the one-win warning and the Edwards injury have all already run.

teams.heading: Julián Montoya returns as Contepomi makes seven changes for France test
teams.body: The captain, who missed the win over Italy in Genoa, came back at hooker for the injured Bautista Bernasconi in Argentina head coach Felipe Contepomi's side for Saturday's Nations Championship match in Paris. Tomás Lavanini replaced Pedro Rubiolo at lock. Juan Martín González was restored on the flank ahead of Pablo Matera, who dropped to the bench. Facundo Isa started at No. 8, shifting Scelzo to openside. Out wide, Gerónimo Prisciantelli took over at full-back from Rodrigo Isgró.

teams.heading: Les Kiss names brand-new Wallabies front row with Tizzano in for McReight
teams.body: Australia head coach Les Kiss started Isaac Kailea, Brandon Paenga-Amosa and Taniela Tupou as a brand-new front row for Saturday's Nations Championship test against Wales in Cardiff. Carlo Tizzano started at flanker in place of Fraser McReight, who moved to the bench, while Tom Hooper shifted into the second row. Kalani Thomas took Tate McDermott's bench spot. Rugby.com.au picked Tizzano against Jac Morgan as the key duel, facing a Wales pack that made a Test-record number of tackles in their first win over New Zealand in 73 years.

teams.heading: Japan crushed 67-5 at Murrayfield as Matsunaga scores lone consolation try
teams.body: Japan conceded 11 tries in Saturday's Nations Championship round six match in Edinburgh, trailing 29-0 at the interval as Scotland wing Darcy Graham and back-rower Liam McConnell each scored hat-tricks. Full-back Takuro Matsunaga's 53rd-minute try came when a box kick bounced awkwardly past wing Kyle Rowe. Replacements Mamoru Harada, for a hip drop, and Michael Stolberg, for an early tackle, were both sin-binned. Planet Rugby noted Japan head coach Eddie Jones had made wholesale changes after the England defeat, only to face a largely second-string Scotland.

lead.why: The Murrayfield result is the newest hard event about Japan; the earlier editions covered only selection.

teams.heading: All Blacks beaten 37-12 by England at Twickenham in Nations Championship
teams.body: Head coach Dave Rennie's side trailed 19-5 at half-time on Saturday and conceded five tries in the Round 6 match against Steve Borthwick's England. Former All Blacks captain Sean Fitzpatrick described New Zealand's first-half performance as terrible on ITV's coverage. The result leaves New Zealand on four wins and two losses from six matches, second of 12 on the log.

teams.heading: Nick Mallett says Rassie Erasmus's six-match ban won't dent Springbok motivation
teams.body: Speaking on the Talking Boks podcast, former Springbok head coach Nick Mallett insisted the six-match ban on head coach Rassie Erasmus would have no detrimental effect on squad motivation. "The one thing that this team knows is that Rassie will do anything for them," he said. SA Rugby have requested a full misconduct hearing, reportedly not before Saturday's Dublin Test against Ireland. Mallett's real concern is longer term: this is Erasmus's third World Rugby sanction since 2021, and Jacques Nienaber is no longer on the coaching staff.

lead.why: The While column and Stick's Prendergast barb have already run, and this is the freshest Springbok-centred take on Erasmus's ban, with SA Rugby's hearing request attached.
